children: may test a support at $2.9325 per lb, a break below which could open the way toward $2.8755.
The contract is riding on a wave c which has briefly travelled below its 50% projection level of $2.9785. It is expected to extend to the 61.8% level of $2.9325.
A further drop to $2.7835 is possible, as the wave c is capable of extending to this level, subject to a break below $2.9325.
Resistance is at $3.0050, a break above which may lead to a gain to $3.0575.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
